title: Localize checkout for international customers
description:
Context: Checkout is English-only, EUR-only, and offers cards and PayPal only, although the shop already ships to several EU markets. Checkout has not followed the international expansion.
Reason: Sales wants five additional markets live this year; support reports non-English tickets already take days to resolve; finance has no position on display currencies and FX pricing. There is no single owner for international checkout.
Scope: Not defined — markets, languages, currencies, and local payment methods are all open.
acceptance_criteria: Given an international customer, when they reach checkout, then checkout is usable for them.
Given a non-EUR market, when prices are displayed, then they are correct for that market.
Given an international order, when it is placed, then it can be fulfilled like a domestic one.
epic_context: Payment Platform Expansion — Alternative Payment Methods
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.
